name: toggle-button
title: ToggleButton
description: A button that stays pressed or unpressed, on Base UI's Toggle, in a ghost or outline variant and three density-aware sizes.

manifest.name: toggle-button
manifest.title: ToggleButton
manifest.description: A button that stays pressed or unpressed, on Base UI's Toggle, in a ghost or outline variant and three density-aware sizes.
manifest.usage: Use ToggleButton for a setting that is on or off and takes effect at once, in a toolbar or next to what it changes: word wrap in an editor, "show nulls" over a grid. Give an icon-only toggle an aria-label naming the setting ("Word wrap"), not the action; the pressed state is announced. For one choice out of several, or several related toggles, use ToggleGroup; for a setting in a form, use Switch or Checkbox.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called when the user presses or releases the toggle.

props.name: variant
props.description: Ghost for toolbars; outline for a toggle that stands next to inputs.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of an icon-only toggle: the setting it turns on.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element with the toggle's props (state.pressed swaps an icon).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The toggle; data-slot="toggle-button", data-variant, data-size and data-pressed name it.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: An optional child icon, sized to size.icon.sm.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over it: color.interactive.hover and color.fg.default.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

accessibility: Renders a native <button> with aria-pressed, so Enter and Space toggle it and screen readers announce "toggle button, pressed".
Icon-only toggles need an aria-label naming the setting ("Word wrap"); keep the name the same in both states, the pressed state carries the change.
Pressed is shown by color.interactive.selected and a change from color.fg.muted to color.fg.default, and announced by aria-pressed, not by colour alone.
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).
